symptom: The exported authority metadata preflight validated own-data descriptors but then read caller-controlled fields again. A later Proxy descriptor trap could repair an initially invalid schema version or witness membership commitment, making the original invalid metadata appear structurally consistent (never independently attested or scorable).
lesson: A standalone metadata validator is an independent untrusted-input boundary even when higher-level batch and proof-request callers already snapshot inputs. A successful own-data shape check does not pin values that later Proxy reads may change.
guardrail: Reuse the bounded descriptor-only snapshot as a separate acyclic research module; snapshot the complete caller graph before semantic checks, reject malformed graphs, and test late repairs with explicit trigger assertions. Preserve all unverified and unscorable outcomes; never infer an independent witness, settlement finality or protocol approval.
